arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Joseffer argued EPA has construed the Act to permit cost consideration.
Mr. Lazarus stated Congress did not authorize EPA to decide benefits did not justify costs.
Ms. Mahoney noted executive orders require cost-benefit analysis for regulations.
